seed_world_description: Ko-ko! Ko-ko! I would be happy to tell you about myself, but I don't remember anything. Either my memory has completely lost its memory, or it was a long time ago...
seed_family_description: I remember there were several dozen of us at my mother's. All so beautiful, slender, young. We ran around the farm for our own pleasure, to the delight of our owners. They loved us very much. They always gave us fresh thick sperm for breakfast, lunch and dinner. And when we got pretty fat, they sold us to new owners. That's how I ended up with you...
seed_occupation_description: In general, I like everything about you, master. The food is wonderful, the chicken coop is cozy. Life without worries! One pleasure... The only thing missing in the chicken coop is a good rooster. I'm a girl, after all. And I want attention too. Well, or at least a girlfriend... And I will thank you in return. Generously! I'll lay you some eggs, not just simple ones, but golden ones...
